svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.
svg.metadata: Snapshot 8293ad0adab0fd5a. Saved 2026-11-10T14:24:38.001Z. Original vector strokes; no external assets.

g.title: Wytie
g.desc: Happy birthday Jaz ❤️ you are the greatest gift i have the pleasure to celebrate everyday not just on the 9th 🫶🏻 words simply cannot describe how many things im grateful to experience with you daily , thank you for being so kind hearted & loving , your constant efforts to make me happy , you deserve the world & may all your dreams be realized and i hope you enjoy your very very special day my sweet girl 🫶🏻 Te amo ❤️❤️

g.title: esthell
g.desc: Trying to keep it brief because if I start saying how I actually feel about you, we're gonna be here all night. You already know though. Words don't really do it justice, but you are everything I can ask from a friend, my lady, far more even. I hope you have a year as wonderful as the ones you've made others experience. Love you♡

g.title: lNED
g.desc: Happy Birthday to one of the most beautiful souls in my life🩷🩷🩷 I honestly don't know where to start because words will never be enough to express how much u mean to me and I hope u know how special u are for me Im so grateful to have u in my life and I hope this new chapter brings u all the happiness love success🥳🥳🩷🩷🩷 and beautiful moments ur heart has ever wished for💋💋💋💋 thank u for being u for ur beautiful heart nd also ur kindness and for bringing ur own special light wherever u go Te amo con todo mi corazón mi lindaaaaa 🩷🩷🩷🪄

g.title: Fear
g.desc:
Happy birthday, my dearest friend. I've officially gone broke paying for this friendship subscription, but it's worth it. You're such a wonderful person, though I must confess, not always. Sometimes you're so loudly wrong and make such questionable decisions, especially that one time you decided to become friends with... me.
Jk, I'm the best and so are you. Have fun you lil goofball! 🎂

g.title: Angy
g.desc: Well, well, it's your birthday Trap ! Hope it's filled with little surprises and big smiles!

g.title: cahv
g.desc: Happy Birthday, Trap ! Enjoy your special day, take care !

g.title: labeeba
g.desc: happy birthday trap!! have a great one

g.title: MADIIROSE
g.desc: Happy birthday Trap!🎂✨ May this next year be filled with happiness and joy. I wish you to receive all that your heart desires. Thank you for all that you do! May God bless you always❤️

g.title: Tyune
g.desc: Happy birthday, pretty girl! May your days always be filled with love, laughter, and all the little things that make your heart happy Stay lovely🎀

g.title: ijenys
g.desc: Happy birthday, TRAP! 🥳 Even though we don’t really know each other yet, hope you have an amazing birthday and a great year ahead. Wishing you all the best and enjoy your day! 🎂

g.title: chuwe
g.desc: Happy birthday, hexceptional Trap! may your day be louder than a hextech explosion💅🏻

g.title: Blsm
g.desc: Wishing you a very HAPPY BIRTHDAY, have a GREAT DAY! 🎂
